function.name: DllMain
function.description: This function is an entry point to a DLL. It is called by the system when processes and threads are initialized and terminated, or upon calls to the LoadLibrary and FreeLibrary functions.

parameters.name: inst
parameters.description: A handle to the DLL module. The value is the base address of the DLL.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason code that indicates why the DLL entry-point function is being called.

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: If the reason code is DLL_PROCESS_DETACH, reserved is NULL for dynamic unloads and nonnull for process termination.

function.return_type: BOOL. If the function succeeds, the return value is TRUE; if it fails, the return value is FALSE.
